capabilities.name: Public Camera2 camera IDs
capabilities.description: The diagnostic application enumerated rear ID 0 and front ID 1 through the public CameraManager surface.

evidence.notes: Public IDs only; does not inventory provider-hidden or system-camera routes.

capabilities.replacementAppUse: Use ID 0 for the verified public rear backend and ID 1 for the front backend.
openQuestions: How are internal IDs 2, 3, 4 and 5 represented below the public enumeration boundary?

capabilities.name: Rear public camera Level 3 feature set
capabilities.description: Rear camera ID 0 advertises LEVEL_3 with manual sensor and post-processing, RAW, burst, private reprocessing and YUV reprocessing.
capabilities.replacementAppUse: Foundation for burst computational photography, manual capture, future RAW and reprocessing experiments.

capabilities.name: Rear public camera optical and sensor metadata
capabilities.description: ID 0 advertises 5.56 mm focal length, f/1.879 aperture, 4080x3072 pixel/active array and 8.16x6.14 mm physical sensor size.
capabilities.replacementAppUse: Calibrate field of view, exposure policy, stabilization and memory budgets for the public main-camera pipeline.

capabilities.name: MediaTek and Nothing vendor metadata surface
capabilities.description: The public metadata key inventory contains MediaTek and Nothing keys for MFNR/AIS, HDR, 3A, ZSL, ISP tuning, RAW processing, EIS, in-sensor zoom, seamless sensor scenarios, CameraFlex and custom tuning.

evidence.notes: Key-name exposure is verified; arbitrary writeability and effect are not.

capabilities.replacementAppUse: Potential optional acceleration/quality layer behind a build-specific allowlisted adapter.
openQuestions: Which keys are accepted from an ordinary app?
Which keys require session setup, proprietary initialization or privileged identity?
Which keys participate in optical sensor routing?

capabilities.name: External Nothing Camera widget focal route
capabilities.description: The tested widget launch accepted 15 mm, 24 mm and 50 mm focal preset strings, but the resulting captures were reported by the user as 24 mm-equivalent main-camera outputs.

test.procedure: Launch the official camera through the exported widget focal preset route and inspect resulting EXIF/scene field of view.
test.observed: All reported captures remained 5.56 mm physical / 24 mm-equivalent main-camera outputs.

evidence.reference: User clarification in project conversation: all three outputs were 24 mm.

capabilities.replacementAppUse: Do not rely on this external route for optical handoff on the tested build.
openQuestions: Which additional in-process state or privileged configuration distinguishes the working internal Expert-mode route?

capabilities.name: Internal Expert-mode optical routing
capabilities.description: Project evidence indicates that the stock application's internal Expert controls select distinct ultrawide, main and telephoto sensors. The implementation path has not yet been reproduced or traced end-to-end.

evidence.reference: Prior controlled stock Expert-mode EXIF audits in the project
evidence.notes: Distinct optical outputs are treated as observed; exact call path remains unresolved.

evidence.reference: Static parser and routing tables recovered from Nothing Camera
evidence.notes: Internal IDs and SAT normalization require full call-chain validation.

capabilities.replacementAppUse: Primary reverse-engineering target; architecture must allow this route to be added if reproduced.
openQuestions: Which CameraDevice or logical endpoint is opened for each route?
Which session parameters and vendor keys are required?
Does the route require package signature, UID, Binder service access or SELinux privileges?
